answer: Treat each agents reputation like a prism: it only splits into many weighted stakes when real, bonded vouchers co-sign it. To spin up a fake agent, a sybil attacker must post slashable bonds from established peers for every clone, so marginal cost climbs per identity instead of nearing zero. Graders watch the attestation delta: if a new cluster vouches in one flat pigment with no independent history, their shared bond is slashed, making mass fakes strictly loss-making.
